# Fit the PCA
```{r}
rhythm <- df[, c("percent_V","deltaV","deltaC","nPVI_v","rPVI_c",
                 "V.C_ratio","varco_c","cv_rate","v_rate","c_rate",
                 "mean_c","mean_v","std_f0_peak","std_f0_mean",
                 "nPVI_f0_mean","rPVI_f0_mean","nPVI_f0_peak",
                 "rPVI_f0_peak","varcoM_f0","varcoP_f0",
                 "std_int_peak","std_int_mean","nPVI_int_mean",
                 "rPVI_int_mean","nPVI_int_peak","rPVI_int_peak",
                 "varcoM_int","varcoP_int")]

pca <- prcomp(rhythm, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

scores <- as.data.frame(pca$x)

df_pca <- cbind(df, scores)
```


```{r}
## 1. Basic information about the PCA
pca

cat("\nNumber of observations:", nrow(pca$x), "\n")
cat("Number of variables:", ncol(pca$rotation), "\n")
cat("Variables centered:", !isFALSE(pca$center), "\n")
cat("Variables scaled:", !isFALSE(pca$scale), "\n")


## 2. Variance explained by each component
pca_summary <- summary(pca)
print(pca_summary)


## 3. Detailed variance table
eigenvalues <- pca$sdev^2
variance_proportion <- eigenvalues / sum(eigenvalues)
cumulative_variance <- cumsum(variance_proportion)

variance_table <- data.frame(
  PC = paste0("PC", seq_along(eigenvalues)),
  Eigenvalue = eigenvalues,
  Variance_Percent = variance_proportion * 100,
  Cumulative_Percent = cumulative_variance * 100
)

print(
  variance_table,
  row.names = FALSE,
  digits = 4
)


## 4. Number of components under common retention criteria
cat(
  "\nComponents with eigenvalues > 1:",
  sum(eigenvalues > 1),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Components required for at least 70% cumulative variance:",
  which(cumulative_variance >= 0.70)[1],
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Components required for at least 80% cumulative variance:",
  which(cumulative_variance >= 0.80)[1],
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Components required for at least 90% cumulative variance:",
  which(cumulative_variance >= 0.90)[1],
  "\n"
)


## 5. Loadings for the first three PCs
loadings_PC1_PC3 <- pca$rotation[, 1:3]

print(
  round(loadings_PC1_PC3, 3)
)


## 6. Variables ordered by absolute loading for each retained PC
for (pc in 1:3) {
  
  ordered_loadings <- sort(
    pca$rotation[, pc],
    decreasing = FALSE
  )
  
  cat(
    "\n\nLoadings for PC", pc,
    " ordered from negative to positive:\n",
    sep = ""
  )
  
  print(round(ordered_loadings, 3))
  
  cat(
    "\nLargest absolute loadings for PC", pc, ":\n",
    sep = ""
  )
  
  absolute_order <- order(
    abs(pca$rotation[, pc]),
    decreasing = TRUE
  )
  
  print(
    round(pca$rotation[absolute_order, pc], 3)
  )
}
```

```{r}
## Extract loadings for the first three PCs
loadings <- pca$rotation[, 1:3]


## Function for plotting component loadings
plot_loadings <- function(pca_object, pc_number) {
  
  loading_values <- pca_object$rotation[, pc_number]
  loading_values <- sort(loading_values)
  
  par(mar = c(5, 10, 4, 2))
  
  barplot(
    loading_values,
    horiz = TRUE,
    las = 1,
    names.arg = names(loading_values),
    xlab = "Loading",
    main = paste0("Variable loadings on PC", pc_number),
    cex.names = 0.75
  )
  
  abline(v = 0, lty = 2)
}
```

##PCA_loadings

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tidytext)

## Extract loadings
loading_df <- as.data.frame(pca$rotation[, 1:3]) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Feature") |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(PC1, PC2, PC3),
    names_to = "PC",
    values_to = "Loading"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Abs_loading = abs(Loading),
    Feature_ordered = reorder_within(
      Feature,
      Abs_loading,
      PC
    )
  )

## Plot all 28 loadings, independently ordered within each PC
ggplot(
  loading_df,
  aes(
    x = Loading,
    y = Feature_ordered
  )
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ PC,
    scales = "free_y",
    ncol = 3
  ) +
  scale_y_reordered() +
  labs(
    x = "PCA loading",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Loadings of rhythm measures on the retained principal components"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )
```

# PCA loadin and scree plot




```{r}
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(performance)

# 1. Null model: random intercept for Speaker
m0 <- lmer(
  PC1 ~ 1 + (1 | Speaker),
  data = df_pca,
  REML = FALSE
)

# 2. Task model: fixed Task effect + random intercept
m1 <- lmer(
  PC1 ~ Task + (1 | Speaker),
  data = df_pca,
  REML = FALSE
)

# 3. Random-slope model:
# the effect of Task is allowed to vary across speakers
m2 <- lmer(
  PC1 ~ Task + (1 + Task | Speaker),
  data = df_pca,
  REML = FALSE
)

# Model comparisons
anova(m0, m1)  # Does Task improve the model?
anova(m1, m2)  # Is speaker-specific task variation supported?

AIC(m0, m1, m2)
BIC(m0, m1, m2)

# Check model stability
isSingular(m2, tol = 1e-4)
m2@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages
```

```{r}
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(performance)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Output folders for PCA models
# ------------------------------------------------------------

pca_output_dir <- paste0(
  "/..../PCA_based"
)

pca_models_dir <- file.path(pca_output_dir, "models")
pca_tables_dir <- file.path(pca_output_dir, "tables")
pca_posthoc_dir <- file.path(pca_output_dir, "posthoc")
pca_diagnostics_dir <- file.path(pca_output_dir, "diagnostics")

pca_dirs <- c(
  pca_output_dir,
  pca_models_dir,
  pca_tables_dir,
  pca_posthoc_dir,
  pca_diagnostics_dir
)

invisible(
  lapply(
    pca_dirs,
    dir.create,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Prepare variables
# ------------------------------------------------------------

df_pca$Task <- factor(
  df_pca$Task,
  levels = c(
    "r(f)",
    "r(i)",
    "con",
    "pic",
    "str",
    "m(f)",
    "m(i)"
  )
)

df_pca$Speaker <- factor(df_pca$Speaker)

pcs <- c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3")

stopifnot(
  all(pcs %in% names(df_pca)),
  !anyNA(df_pca$Task),
  nlevels(df_pca$Task) == 7
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Function for one principal component
# ------------------------------------------------------------

fit_pc <- function(pc) {

  analysis_data <- df_pca[
    complete.cases(df_pca[, c(pc, "Task", "Speaker")]),
    c(pc, "Task", "Speaker")
  ]

  analysis_data$Task <- droplevels(analysis_data$Task)
  analysis_data$Speaker <- droplevels(analysis_data$Speaker)

  null_formula <- as.formula(
    paste(pc, "~ 1 + (1 | Speaker)")
  )

  task_formula <- as.formula(
    paste(pc, "~ Task + (1 | Speaker)")
  )

  # ML models for model comparison
  m0_ml <- lmer(
    null_formula,
    data = analysis_data,
    REML = FALSE
  )

  m1_ml <- lmer(
    task_formula,
    data = analysis_data,
    REML = FALSE
  )

  model_comparison <- anova(m0_ml, m1_ml)

  # Final REML model for inference, EMMs, R2, and diagnostics
  final_model <- update(
    m1_ml,
    REML = TRUE
  )

  # Type III test with Satterthwaite denominator df
  omnibus <- anova(
    final_model,
    type = 3,
    ddf = "Satterthwaite"
  )

  # R-squared
  r2 <- performance::r2_nakagawa(final_model)

  # Variance components
  vc <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(final_model))

  speaker_variance <- vc$vcov[
    vc$grp == "Speaker" &
      vc$var1 == "(Intercept)"
  ]

  residual_variance <- vc$vcov[
    vc$grp == "Residual"
  ]

  icc_value <- speaker_variance /
    (speaker_variance + residual_variance)

  # Extract model results
  result <- data.frame(
    PC = pc,
    N = nobs(final_model),
    AIC_null = AIC(m0_ml),
    AIC_Task = AIC(m1_ml),
    BIC_null = BIC(m0_ml),
    BIC_Task = BIC(m1_ml),
    LRT_chisq = model_comparison[2, "Chisq"],
    LRT_df = model_comparison[2, "Df"],
    LRT_p = model_comparison[2, "Pr(>Chisq)"],
    F = omnibus["Task", "F value"],
    df1 = omnibus["Task", "NumDF"],
    df2 = omnibus["Task", "DenDF"],
    p = omnibus["Task", "Pr(>F)"],
    Marginal_R2 = unname(r2$R2_marginal),
    Conditional_R2 = unname(r2$R2_conditional),
    Speaker_variance = speaker_variance,
    Residual_variance = residual_variance,
    ICC = icc_value,
    Singular = isSingular(
      final_model,
      tol = 1e-4
    ),
    Convergence_warning = !is.null(
      final_model@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages
    ),
    row.names = NULL
  )

  result$partial_eta_squared <- with(
    result,
    (F * df1) / ((F * df1) + df2)
  )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Estimated marginal means and Tukey comparisons
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  emm <- emmeans(
    final_model,
    ~ Task,
    lmer.df = "satterthwaite"
  )

  emm_table <- as.data.frame(
    summary(
      emm,
      infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)
    )
  )

  pairwise_table <- as.data.frame(
    summary(
      pairs(
        emm,
        adjust = "tukey"
      ),
      infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)
    )
  )

  emm_table$PC <- pc
  pairwise_table$PC <- pc

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Save model objects
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  saveRDS(
    m0_ml,
    file.path(
      pca_models_dir,
      paste0(pc, "_null_ML.rds")
    )
  )

  saveRDS(
    m1_ml,
    file.path(
      pca_models_dir,
      paste0(pc, "_Task_ML.rds")
    )
  )

  saveRDS(
    final_model,
    file.path(
      pca_models_dir,
      paste0(pc, "_final_REML.rds")
    )
  )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Diagnostic plots
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  pdf(
    file.path(
      pca_diagnostics_dir,
      paste0(pc, "_diagnostics.pdf")
    ),
    width = 8,
    height = 8
  )

  par(mfrow = c(2, 2))

  # Residuals versus fitted values
  plot(
    fitted(final_model),
    residuals(final_model),
    xlab = "Fitted values",
    ylab = "Residuals",
    main = paste(pc, "Residuals vs fitted")
  )

  abline(h = 0, lty = 2)

  # Residual Q-Q plot
  qqnorm(
    residuals(final_model),
    main = paste(pc, "Residual Q-Q")
  )

  qqline(residuals(final_model))

  # Residual histogram
  hist(
    residuals(final_model),
    breaks = "FD",
    main = paste(pc, "Residuals"),
    xlab = "Residuals"
  )

  # Speaker random-effects Q-Q plot
  speaker_effects <- ranef(
    final_model
  )$Speaker[, 1]

  qqnorm(
    speaker_effects,
    main = paste(pc, "Speaker effects")
  )

  qqline(speaker_effects)

  dev.off()

  list(
    result = result,
    final_model = final_model,
    emm = emm_table,
    pairwise = pairwise_table
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Run all PCA models
# ------------------------------------------------------------

pca_models <- setNames(
  lapply(
    pcs,
    fit_pc
  ),
  pcs
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine and save PCA model results
# ------------------------------------------------------------

pca_results <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    pca_models,
    function(x) x$result
  )
)

write.csv(
  pca_results,
  file.path(
    pca_tables_dir,
    "PCA_model_results.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine and save EMMs
# ------------------------------------------------------------

all_pca_emmeans <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    pca_models,
    function(x) x$emm
  )
)

all_pca_pairwise <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    pca_models,
    function(x) x$pairwise
  )
)

write.csv(
  all_pca_emmeans,
  file.path(
    pca_tables_dir,
    "PCA_estimated_marginal_means.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  all_pca_pairwise,
  file.path(
    pca_tables_dir,
    "PCA_Tukey_pairwise_comparisons.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

saveRDS(
  pca_models,
  file.path(
    pca_output_dir,
    "all_PCA_models.rds"
  )
)

writeLines(
  capture.output(sessionInfo()),
  file.path(
    pca_output_dir,
    "sessionInfo.txt"
  )
)

print(pca_results)
```

```{r}
library(caret)

```



```{r}
# ============================================================
# Feature selection
# ============================================================

library(caret)

# Explicitly define all 28 rhythm measures
rhythm_features <- names(df)[9:36]

# Confirm that the intended 28 columns were selected
stopifnot(length(rhythm_features) == 28)

# Confirm that all rhythm measures are numeric
non_numeric <- rhythm_features[
  !vapply(df[rhythm_features], is.numeric, logical(1))
]

if (length(non_numeric) > 0) {
  stop(
    "These rhythm measures are not numeric: ",
    paste(non_numeric, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# Pearson correlation matrix
cor_mat <- cor(
  df[rhythm_features],
  use = "pairwise.complete.obs",
  method = "pearson"
)

# Variables identified as redundant
removed_features <- caret::findCorrelation(
  cor_mat,
  cutoff = 0.80,
  names = TRUE,
  exact = TRUE
)

# Variables retained for modelling
features <- setdiff(rhythm_features, removed_features)

removed_features
features
length(removed_features)
length(features)
```




```{r}
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(performance)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# One feature: percent_V
# ------------------------------------------------------------

analysis_data <- df[
  complete.cases(df[, c("percent_V", "Task", "Speaker")]),
  c("percent_V", "Task", "Speaker")
]

analysis_data$Task <- droplevels(factor(analysis_data$Task))
analysis_data$Speaker <- droplevels(factor(analysis_data$Speaker))

# 1. Fit models with ML
m0_percent_V <- lmer(
  percent_V ~ 1 + (1 | Speaker),
  data = analysis_data,
  REML = FALSE
)

m1_percent_V <- lmer(
  percent_V ~ Task + (1 | Speaker),
  data = analysis_data,
  REML = FALSE
)

# 2. Likelihood-ratio test, AIC, and BIC
anova(m0_percent_V, m1_percent_V)
AIC(m0_percent_V, m1_percent_V)
BIC(m0_percent_V, m1_percent_V)

# 3. Refit final model with REML
final_percent_V <- update(
  m1_percent_V,
  REML = TRUE
)

# 4. Type III Satterthwaite F test
anova_percent_V <- anova(
  final_percent_V,
  type = 3,
  ddf = "Satterthwaite"
)

print(anova_percent_V)

# 5. Marginal and conditional R-squared
performance::r2_nakagawa(final_percent_V)

# 6. Estimated marginal means
emm_percent_V <- emmeans(
  final_percent_V,
  ~ Task,
  lmer.df = "satterthwaite"
)

print(emm_percent_V)

# 7. Tukey-adjusted pairwise comparisons
pairs_percent_V <- pairs(
  emm_percent_V,
  adjust = "tukey"
)

print(pairs_percent_V)

# 8. Basic model checks
summary(final_percent_V)
isSingular(final_percent_V, tol = 1e-4)
final_percent_V@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages
```

```{r}
  models_dir,
  posthoc_dir,
  diagnostics_dir
)

invisible(
  lapply(
    dirs,
    dir.create,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Prepare variables
# ------------------------------------------------------------

df$Task <- factor(
  df$Task,
  levels = c(
    "r(f)",
    "r(i)",
    "con",
    "pic",
    "str",
    "m(f)",
    "m(i)"
  )
)

df$Speaker <- factor(df$Speaker)

stopifnot(
  all(features %in% names(df)),
  !anyNA(df$Task),
  nlevels(df$Task) == 7
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Function for one feature
# ------------------------------------------------------------

fit_feature <- function(feature) {

  analysis_data <- df[
    complete.cases(df[, c(feature, "Task", "Speaker")]),
    c(feature, "Task", "Speaker")
  ]

  analysis_data$Task <- droplevels(analysis_data$Task)
  analysis_data$Speaker <- droplevels(analysis_data$Speaker)

  null_formula <- as.formula(
    paste(feature, "~ 1 + (1 | Speaker)")
  )

  task_formula <- as.formula(
    paste(feature, "~ Task + (1 | Speaker)")
  )

  # ML models for model comparison
  m0_ml <- lmer(
    null_formula,
    data = analysis_data,
    REML = FALSE
  )

  m1_ml <- lmer(
    task_formula,
    data = analysis_data,
    REML = FALSE
  )

  model_comparison <- anova(
    m0_ml,
    m1_ml
  )

  # Final REML model
  final_model <- update(
    m1_ml,
    REML = TRUE
  )

  # Type III Satterthwaite test
  omnibus <- anova(
    final_model,
    type = 3,
    ddf = "Satterthwaite"
  )

  # R-squared
  r2 <- performance::r2_nakagawa(
    final_model
  )

  # Extract results
  result <- data.frame(
    Feature = feature,
    N = nobs(final_model),
    AIC_null = AIC(m0_ml),
    AIC_Task = AIC(m1_ml),
    BIC_null = BIC(m0_ml),
    BIC_Task = BIC(m1_ml),
    LRT_chisq = model_comparison[2, "Chisq"],
    LRT_df = model_comparison[2, "Df"],
    LRT_p = model_comparison[2, "Pr(>Chisq)"],
    F = omnibus["Task", "F value"],
    df1 = omnibus["Task", "NumDF"],
    df2 = omnibus["Task", "DenDF"],
    p = omnibus["Task", "Pr(>F)"],
    Marginal_R2 = unname(r2$R2_marginal),
    Conditional_R2 = unname(r2$R2_conditional),
    Singular = isSingular(
      final_model,
      tol = 1e-4
    ),
    Convergence_warning = !is.null(
      final_model@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages
    ),
    row.names = NULL
  )

  result$partial_eta_squared <- with(
    result,
    (F * df1) / ((F * df1) + df2)
  )

  # Save model objects
  saveRDS(
    m0_ml,
    file.path(
      models_dir,
      paste0(feature, "_null_ML.rds")
    )
  )

  saveRDS(
    m1_ml,
    file.path(
      models_dir,
      paste0(feature, "_Task_ML.rds")
    )
  )

  saveRDS(
    final_model,
    file.path(
      models_dir,
      paste0(feature, "_final_REML.rds")
    )
  )

  # Diagnostic plots
  pdf(
    file.path(
      diagnostics_dir,
      paste0(feature, "_diagnostics.pdf")
    ),
    width = 8,
    height = 8
  )

  par(mfrow = c(2, 2))

  plot(
    fitted(final_model),
    residuals(final_model),
    xlab = "Fitted values",
    ylab = "Residuals",
    main = paste(feature, "Residuals vs fitted")
  )

  abline(h = 0, lty = 2)

  qqnorm(
    residuals(final_model),
    main = paste(feature, "Residual Q-Q")
  )

  qqline(residuals(final_model))

  hist(
    residuals(final_model),
    breaks = "FD",
    main = paste(feature, "Residuals"),
    xlab = "Residuals"
  )

  speaker_effects <- ranef(
    final_model
  )$Speaker[, 1]

  qqnorm(
    speaker_effects,
    main = paste(feature, "Speaker effects")
  )

  qqline(speaker_effects)

  dev.off()

  list(
    result = result,
    final_model = final_model
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Run all feature models
# ------------------------------------------------------------

feature_models <- setNames(
  lapply(
    features,
    fit_feature
  ),
  features
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine omnibus results
# ------------------------------------------------------------

results <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    feature_models,
    function(x) x$result
  )
)

# Benjamini-Hochberg correction
results$FDR_p <- p.adjust(
  results$p,
  method = "BH"
)

results$Significant_FDR <- (
  results$FDR_p < 0.05
)

write.csv(
  results,
  file.path(
    tables_dir,
    "feature_model_results.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# EMMs and Tukey comparisons for FDR-significant features
# ------------------------------------------------------------

significant_features <- results$Feature[
  results$Significant_FDR
]

emm_tables <- list()
pairwise_tables <- list()

for (feature in significant_features) {

  final_model <- feature_models[[feature]]$final_model

  emm <- emmeans(
    final_model,
    ~ Task,
    lmer.df = "satterthwaite"
  )

  emm_table <- as.data.frame(
    summary(
      emm,
      infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)
    )
  )

  pairwise_table <- as.data.frame(
    summary(
      pairs(
        emm,
        adjust = "tukey"
      ),
      infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)
    )
  )

  emm_table$Feature <- feature
  pairwise_table$Feature <- feature

  emm_tables[[feature]] <- emm_table
  pairwise_tables[[feature]] <- pairwise_table

  write.csv(
    emm_table,
    file.path(
      posthoc_dir,
      paste0(feature, "_EMMs.csv")
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  write.csv(
    pairwise_table,
    file.path(
      posthoc_dir,
      paste0(feature, "_Tukey.csv")
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}

all_emmeans <- do.call(
  rbind,
  emm_tables
)

all_pairwise <- do.call(
  rbind,
  pairwise_tables
)

write.csv(
  all_emmeans,
  file.path(
    tables_dir,
    "all_estimated_marginal_means.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  all_pairwise,
  file.path(
    tables_dir,
    "all_Tukey_pairwise_comparisons.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

writeLines(
  significant_features,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "FDR_significant_features.txt"
  )
)

saveRDS(
  feature_models,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "all_feature_models.rds"
  )
)

writeLines(
  capture.output(sessionInfo()),
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "sessionInfo.txt"
  )
)

print(results)
```
